item.title: China's old-age dependency ratio overtakes children for first time
item.description: China is now supporting more people aged 65 and above than children, underscoring the impact of its rapidly ageing population and a declining birth rate.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China is now supporting more people aged 65 and above than children, underscoring the impact of its rapidly ageing population and a declining birth rate. Data from China's National Bureau of Statistics showed the old-age dependency ratio — the non-working-age population compared to the working-age population — was 23.1% in 2025, compared with 22% for children, Chinese state-affiliated media Yicai reported The ratio has risen steadily over the years, up from 15% in 2016 to more than 20% in 2021 There are now more than 223 million people in China aged 65 and above compared with around 213 million children aged 14 and under, the data showed China's population fell for a fourth straight year in 2025, as its birth rate dropped to a record low The country's birth rate has been falling for decades, a result of the one-child policy in place from 1980 to 2015, as well as rapid urbanisation Authorities have rolled out a range of measures to encourage marriage and childbearing, including family subsidies, childcare support, and reduced childbirth-related medical costs They have also pledged to make urban life more supportive for young people, children and families

item.title: Natural gas is losing its grip across key power markets
item.description: Natural gas was supposed to be the dominant bridge fuel between legacy generation systems and a clean-powered future. But across key markets in Europe and Asia, power producers appear to be increasingly bypassing the fuel in favour of other options.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Maguire
item.content:encoded: Natural gas was supposed to be the dominant bridge fuel between legacy generation systems and a clean-powered future. But across key markets in Europe and Asia, power producers appear to be increasingly bypassing the fuel in favour of other options. Total electricity generation from gas-fired power plants has contracted this year from 2025 in the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Turkey, Japan, South Korea and China, according to data from think tank Ember. Those countries represent some of the key traditional and high-potential gas markets for gas power generation, and yet all simultaneously pared back gas use this year as global supplies and prices were impacted by the war in the Middle East. Significantly, total electricity generation across those six nations has expanded this year despite lower collective gas-fired output, resulting in natural gas losing share to other generation sources within those key power networks. For exporters of liquefied natural gas, the risk is that gas remains essential as a marginal fuel but ceases to be a growth engine for power generation. Power systems still need gas-fired plants to bolster reliability, but they appear to need progressively less gas-fired electricity from those facilities as renewable generation, storage and output from other power sources expand. That is a challenging outlook for an industry investing heavily in new export capacity on the assumption that tomorrow's power sector will burn substantially more gas than today's. SHARE SQUEEZE The steady erosion of natural gas' share within a wide span of key power sectors underscores the problem for gas market bulls. In the Netherlands, home to Europe's main gas trading hub, the gas share of electricity generation during the first nine months of 2026 was just under 32%. That's the lowest reading on record for that period and compares to a nearly 60% gas share in the same months in 2020 and nearly 40% in 2022. In the United Kingdom, the closure of the country's last remaining coal power plant in late 2024 was expected to trigger a sustained upturn in gas use. Yet gas' share of the utility mix plumbed a new low of 29% so far this year, compared to roughly 41% in the same months in 2022. And in Turkey, which was long considered a viable growth market for gas due to its fast-growing manufacturing base, gas' share of the generation mix this year has dropped to just under 11%. That compares to an average 32% gas share in 2021, which is when Turkey's gas-fired generation total hit a record and spurred optimism among gas exporters that the country would continue to steadily increase its gas needs. Gas has also lost ground across key Asian markets. In Japan, which for years has been one of the top LNG importers, gas use in electricity generation has lost ground to both rising output from renewables and a recovery in output from the country's nuclear reactor fleet. The gas share of Japan's electricity mix so far this year was 28.4%, which was the first reading on record below 30%, and compares to an average share of around 35% in 2022 and nearly 40% in 2019. South Korea's power system also reduced gas' share to a multi-year low of just under 29% this year, while in China gas' share of the mix was just 3.07%, which again was a record low. ABSOLUTE PEAK? For gas market bulls, the trends in absolute levels of gas-fired generation are also likely to be a cause for concern. In all six of the key markets noted above, year-to-date generation from gas-fired power plants has posted a decline this year, just as output from many other sources has increased in 2026. In Europe, higher output from renewables installations alongside battery storage networks has allowed most utilities to boost total electricity supplies while cutting overall gas generation. In Turkey, a jump in hydro power production to the highest in over five years also allowed for lower gas consumption. In Asia, power producers dialled up generation from cheaper coal-fired power stations to accommodate tighter gas supplies, which have been hampered by the US and Israeli war against Iran and the subsequent drops in [USN:S8N40Y05J TEXT:"LNG shipments from Qatar"]. The worrying signal for LNG producers is that this decline has occurred even before a new wave of gas export capacity comes online. Major suppliers are investing billions of dollars on the assumption that power demand growth will translate into rising gas consumption for decades to come. Yet across several of the world's most important gas-burning economies, utilities are finding ways to grow electricity supplies while reducing reliance on gas-fired generation. If that pattern spreads further, the industry's challenge may not be securing enough supply to meet future demand, but finding enough demand to absorb future supply. Gas may remain indispensable in many modern power systems, but the latest generation trends suggest it is increasingly valued for reliability rather than volume. That's an uncomfortable distinction for exporters betting on sustained growth. The opinions expressed here are those of the author , a columnist for Reuters. Enjoying this column? item.title: 英ＧＳＫ、がん分野に注力 試験段階の治療薬倍増へ
item.description: ［２７日 ロイター］ - 英製薬大手グラクソ・スミスクライン（ＧＳＫ） は２７日、オンコロジー（がん）事業の再建を図る...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英ＧＳＫ、がん分野に注力　試験段階の治療薬倍増へ 14:58 配信

写真はＧＳＫのロゴ。2022年8月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［２７日　ロイター］ - 英製薬大手グラクソ・スミスクライン（ＧＳＫ） は２７日、オンコロジー（がん）事業の再建を図るため、初期段階の試験を含む臨床試験中のがん治療薬の数を来年、ほぼ倍増させるとの見通しを明らかにした。

オンコロジー研究開発部門を率いるヘシャム・アブドラ氏は同日、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）に、同社の臨床開発段階にある約１５の開発候補からなるポートフォリオは、２０２７年に「ほぼ倍増する」見通しだと語った。

ルーク・マイルズ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の下で、同社はがん治療薬に注力している。今年、米バイオ医薬品会社ヌーバレントの１０６億ドルで買収し、買収を通じて取得した薬剤のうち１つは７月に承認を取得し、もう１つについては１１月までに承認可否が判断される見込み。

オンコロジー製品開発責任者のエリック・リチャーズ氏は今週開催された医学会議でロイターに対し、「２０２７年には第３相臨床試験が２０件近く行われる可能性がある」と明らかにした。

がん治療薬「ｒｉｓ－ｒｅｚ（リスレズ）」と「ｍｏ－ｒｅｚ（モーレズ）」はＧＳＫのオンコロジー戦略の中核を担う。ＧＳＫと中国バイオ医薬品会社の翰森製薬（ハンソー・ファーマシューティカル）が２６日に発表したリスレズのデータによると、同薬は治療が困難ながん患者において、病状を悪化させることなく生存期間を延長することが示された。

モーレズに関しては、５つの後期試験が進行中で、リスレズについても計画されている４件の試験のうち２件が進められている。

がん治療薬事業の上半期売上高は１０億８０００万ポンド（１４億４０００万ドル）だった。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：中国製薬企業、国際人材の確保難しく　海外治験や新薬商業化に壁 アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 10/28(水) 14:58 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Danantara bids for stake in Indonesian stock exchange, bourse chief says
item.description: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara has submitted a bid to buy a stake in the country's stock exchange as the bourse prepares for demutualisation, the exchange's chief executive said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara has submitted a bid to buy a stake in the country's stock exchange as the bourse prepares for demutualisation, the exchange's chief executive said on Wednesday. Danantara's proposal is being considered while the exchange awaits bids from other parties, Jeffrey Hendrik told reporters, without providing details on the proposal.

item.title: UBS meets expectations with $2.7 billion Q3 profit
item.description: UBS reported a third-quarter net profit of $2.69 billion on Wednesday, up 8% year-on-year and roughly in line with the $2.71 billion expected as per a company-provided consensus forecast.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UBS (UBSG.S) reported a third-quarter net profit of $2.69 billion on Wednesday, up 8% year-on-year and roughly in line with the $2.71 billion expected as per a company-provided consensus forecast. The performance of the largest Swiss bank was supported by net new assets of $55 billion in global wealth management, driven by inflows of $18 billion in Asia and $17 billion in the Americas. Profitability in the Americas improved, with the profit-before-tax margin up by over 2 percentage points, UBS said. The integration of former rival Credit Suisse is on track for completion by year-end, the bank added, with cumulative cost savings by end-2026 now expected at around $13.7 billion, up from around $13.5 billion. Staff levels dropped by almost 1,500 full-time employees in the quarter as integration progressed. Employees at the bank are running more than 12,700 personal AI agents and the bank keeps investing in the technology, UBS said. The bank's cost-income ratio dropped to 72.3% at the end of the third quarter from 77% a year earlier. UBS repurchased $1.8 billion of shares in the quarter and plans to complete its buyback program of $3 billion in February, rather than by the mid-2027 timeline it had announced previously. The bank has [USN:L1N43V04F TEXT:"conditioned"] the amount and pace of share buybacks on the outcome of a Swiss banking rules overhaul that follows the 2023 collapse of Credit Suisse and its state-engineered emergency takeover by UBS. New capital rules for UBS are currently being [USN:L1N45N0NB TEXT:"debated"] in a parliamentary committee and expected to reach the lower house floor in December. The Swiss upper house last month [USN:L8N45F0DE TEXT:"proposed"] rules that UBS suggested were unacceptable. UBS's chairman has warned the bank would need to carefully [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"consider"] its future in Switzerland if capital requirements are too harsh, and some shareholders have called for UBS to [USN:L1N45N061 TEXT:"leave"] Switzerland. UBS hopes that parliament will reach a solution that supports Switzerland's financial stability without imposing undue costs on UBS's shareholders, clients and employees, the bank said in its results presentation.

item.title: 印通信ジオが上場、初値は公開価格21％上回る リライアンス傘下
item.description:
Vibhuti Sharma Aditya Kalra
[ムンバイ ２８日 ロイター] - インド大手財閥リライアン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
印通信ジオが上場、初値は公開価格21％上回る　リライアンス傘下 14:52 配信

写真はジオの上場セレモニーの様子。28日、印ムンバイで撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas（ロイター） Vibhuti Sharma　Aditya Kalra

[ムンバイ ２８日 ロイター] - インド大手財閥リライアンス傘下の通信会社ジオ・プラットフォームズが２８日、ムンバイ市場に上場し、初値が公開価格を約２１％上回った。

富豪ムケシュ・アンバニ氏傘下の同社は５億３０００万人超の顧客を抱え、メタ・プラットフォームズとアルファベット傘下のグーグルが出資する。単一国の通信事業契約者数では、中国移動（チャイナ・モバイル）に次ぐ規模だ。

リライアンス傘下企業の上場は２０年ぶり。石油・化学を中心とする複合企業から消費財やテクノロジーまで「あらゆるものを手がける企業」に転換するアンバニ氏の構想を前進させる。

初値は１株１３５８ルピーで、公開価格の１１１９ルピーを上回った。時価総額は約１３１５億ドルで、バーティ・エアテルとＨＤＦＣ銀行を抜きインド企業で２位となった。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：北朝鮮が韓国と対立姿勢、米国にとって新たな悩みの種に アングル：主要国債利回りが軒並み歴史的高水準、債務持続性巡る不安と利上げ圧力で アングル：韓国半導体大手2社の巨額還元、「コリア・ディスカウント」是正の試金石 アングル：インド、待望の民間投資復活の兆し　政府主導から成長エンジン多様化 10/28(水) 14:52 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: AI chips worth US$12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday (Oct 28) that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit (US$12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling high-performance semiconductors through the country's main airport.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

AI chips worth US$12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday (Oct 28) that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit (US$12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling high-performance semiconductors through the country's main airport. Malaysia imposed export controls last year on the movement of advanced AI chips of US origin, following pressure from the United States to stem their flow into China. On Oct 15, authorities found 30 server units containing advanced AI chips during an inspection at Kuala Lumpur International Airport's free trade zone, the airport's customs director Aspalila Ag Tuah told reporters. Initial investigations found that the shipment, originating from an Asian country, was to be re-exported to another nation in the continent, a move that required a trade permit, she said.

"The servers were falsely declared as electronic components ... and shipped through Malaysia to ensure there would be no restrictions imposed while being exported to the next destination," Aspalila said.

Malaysia's customs department officers show a pallet of server units containing advanced AI chips during a press conference on the department's seizure of 72 server units containing advanced AI chips at Sepang, Malaysia, on Jun 26, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Hasnoor Hussain)

A Malaysian firm that facilitated the shipment has been called in to assist investigations, she added. The shipment was suspected to have been carried out by a network responsible for a similar smuggling attempt foiled by customs authorities in June, she said. At least five cases were linked to the syndicate, involving seizures of chips worth more than 100 million ringgit in total, she said, declining to divulge further details citing an ongoing probe.

item.title: アングル：カカクコムにみる買収競争の新局面、シナジーが「入札価格」押し上げ
item.description:
Miho Uranaka Anton Bridge
[東京 ２８日 ロイター] - 日本のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）市場でプ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：カカクコムにみる買収競争の新局面、シナジーが「入札価格」押し上げ 14:51 配信

都内のビル群。2014年7月11日撮影。REUTERS/Toru Hanai（ロイター） Miho Uranaka　Anton Bridge

[東京 ２８日 ロイター] - 日本のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）市場でプライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドが成長を求める事業会社と組んで買収に臨む動きが広がりつつある。資金力を持つファンドと事業基盤を持つ企業が組んでシナジー（相乗効果）を示しながら買収を進める手法は新たな潮流になる可能性も秘める。争奪戦が続くカカクコムを巡っても、５月に公開買い付け（ＴＯＢ）を開始した欧州系投資ファンドＥＱＴに対し、米投資ファンドのベイン・キャピタルとＬＩＮＥヤフー（ＬＹ）陣営が対抗提案で追い上げている。

＜どれだけ事業価値を高められるか＞

ファンドと事業会社による買収提案では、光通信がＭＢＫパートナーズ、ＮＥＣキャピタルソリューション系ファンドと組み、レオパレス２１の非公開化に向けたＴＯＢも実施中だ。

事業会社の参加が注目される最大の理由は、シナジーを具体的に価格へ織り込めることにある。ファンド単独では見積もりにくい再編効果や成長余地を、事業会社は自社の事業として評価できる。その分だけ提示できる価格も上がる可能性がある。

カカクコムの争奪戦では、この構図が鮮明になっている。関係者によると、「価格.com」「食べログ」「求人ボックス」の３事業に、ＬＹの送客力とグループ会社でスマホアプリ決済大手のＰａｙＰａｙを含む決済を組み合わせれば、国内で巨大なバリューチェーンを構築できるため、これ以上の価値向上を生める相手はいないと主張する。組めば企業価値はそれなりに高くなるとの考えだ。

関係者は、ＬＹが進めてきた過去の買収でも、予約サイトの一休は売上高がほぼ１０倍、アパレル通販のＺＯＺＯは２倍超になったとの実績を示し、シナジー効果の創出に自信を示す。

ＥＱＴは５月にＴＯＢを始め、度重なる価格引き上げと期間延長を経て、現在は３６８２円としている。対してベイン・ＬＹ陣営は、対抗提案した後、引き上げを重ねた。現在、大株主のＫＤＤＩの協力が得られれば３７２０円、得られなければ３７００円とする条件を示し、いずれもＥＱＴの提示価格を上回る。

英法律事務所フレッシュフィールズのパートナー、グレゴリー・サラテ氏は「特定の業界に関する深い知見や、対象企業の経営陣との関係を持つ事業会社と組んでいる場合、買収プロセスの初期段階で有利になる」と指摘する。対象企業との間で信頼関係を築きやすく、経営陣の理解も深まるためだという。

カーライルの渡辺雄介パートナーは、最近の上場企業案件ではオークション（入札）形式となることが多く、最終的には対象企業の事業価値をどれだけ高められるかが勝敗を左右すると指摘。企業の成長余地を大きく引き出せると判断できれば、その分だけ高い買収価格を提示することも可能になるため、事業会社との連携によって企業価値を一段と高められるのであれば、「一緒にやりましょう」という発想は以前にも増して広がっているとの見方を示した。

事業会社の姿勢も変わってきており、最近は成長を求めて積極的に競り合う姿勢に変化してきたとし、対抗ＴＯＢを出しやすい状況になってきていると指摘するファンドの関係者もみられた。

＜「相対交渉のみ」に限界、連携には課題も＞

事業会社が買収の担い手として存在感を高める中、証券会社でファンドに関わる部署の幹部は、アクティビストは株価向上が見込める割安な会社をターゲットにする一方で、事業会社は戦略的な意義があれば必ずしも株価が割安とは言えなくとも買収に動く可能性がある「最も恐ろしい相手」だという。

連携には課題もある。ＢｏｆＡ証券の投資銀行部門共同部門長兼Ｍ＆Ａ共同責任者の間中章彦氏は、一般的に「コンソーシアムを組成した買収者は、単独買収者と比較して、意思決定や交渉のスピードという観点で売主から懸念を持たれやすい傾向にある」と話す。

以前は、ファンドが相対で交渉を進め、そのまま発表に至るケースも多かった。しかし最近は、プロセスに呼ばれなかった事業会社やファンドなどの買い手が後から対抗提案を出すケースも増えている。積極的なマーケット・チェックを行わない場合、後から対抗提案が出る可能性を完全には排除できなくなってきている。

昨今のＭ＆Ａ市場における競争環境を踏まえれば、会社側も買い手側も潜在的な競合提案の可能性を十分に吟味する必要性が増しており、事前にバンカーや弁護士を含めた対応が求められるようになったと、間中氏は語る。

マンダムの事例では、欧州投資ファンドＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズ系と創業家を含む経営陣が組んだＭＢＯ（経営陣が参加する買収）のＴＯＢ価格が、旧村上系株主の反発を受けて当初の１９６０円から引き上げられた。その過程で米投資ファンドのＫＫＲが対抗提案を出し、ＭＢＯ側は３１０５円に引き上げて決着した。

あるＰＥファンドの関係者は、相対交渉で少しでも安く買いたいという発想は理解できるとしつつ、ＴＯＢという仕組みである以上、一定の公正な価格を示す必要があると強調した。

item.title: Equinor profit doubles as Middle East war lifts oil, gas prices
item.description: Equinor on Wednesday reported its strongest quarterly profit in almost four years, driven by a surge in oil and gas prices as the war in the Middle East continued to disrupt global energy supplies, and raised its full-year output target.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Equinor (EQNR.OL) on Wednesday reported its strongest quarterly profit in almost four years, driven by a surge in oil and gas prices as the war in the Middle East continued to disrupt global energy supplies, and raised its full-year output target. The Norwegian group's adjusted earnings before tax for the July to September period rose to $12.34 billion from $6.22 billion a year earlier, slightly ahead of the $12.19 billion predicted in a poll of 21 analysts compiled by Equinor. "High production in the third quarter enabled us to capture additional value from higher prices," CEO Anders Opedal said in a statement. Equinor now expects its oil and gas output to rise by around 4% this year, up from 3% growth seen previously. The shares of majority state-owned Equinor are up 86% year-to-date, trading at all-time highs in recent weeks. They are outperforming a 43% increase in European energy stocks (.SXEP) , reflecting Equinor's position as a major supplier of oil and gas to Europe and with no direct exposure to the Middle East.

item.title: BNP Paribas beats Q3 profit forecast, unveils €1.3 billion share buyback
item.description: BNP Paribas posted a forecast-beating rise in third-quarter profit on Wednesday, aided by its investment bankers, as the lender announced a €1.3 billion ($1.45 billion) share buyback and played down the impact of soaring government bond yields.
item.dc:creator: Mateusz Rabiega
item.content:encoded: BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) posted a forecast-beating rise in third-quarter profit on Wednesday, aided by its investment bankers, as the lender announced a €1.3 billion ($1.45 billion) share buyback and played down the impact of soaring government bond yields. France's BNP said quarterly net income climbed 14% to €3.46 billion, beating the €3.23 billion average forecast of analysts polled by the bank. Revenue at the euro zone's biggest bank by assets rose year-on-year to €13.76 billion, slightly above expectations. BNP is reporting alongside a flurry of European banks this week including Deutsche Bank (DBKGn.DE) , UBS (UBSG.S) , and Santander (SAN.MC) , with investors watching closely to see if lenders can sustain recent record profits. HSBC on Tuesday sent a chill through the sector after it [USN:L2N46D02S TEXT:"disappointed "]with its revenue growth, sending its shares down nearly 7%. French banks face further challenges, with soaring euro zone sovereign bond yields - [USN:L6N4680JY TEXT:"especially in France"] amid concerns about the country's fiscal position - [USN:L6N4610RI TEXT:"reviving worries about lenders' exposure to government debt."] BNP said its exposure to French sovereign bonds was limited, roughly at €19 billion at end-September and that France accounted for under 10% of its pre-tax income last year. EQUITY TRADING JUMPS The French lender's results were helped for a second consecutive quarter by a record jump in equity and prime services revenue. The 50% rise year-on-year surpassed the average 37% gain in equities trading across the top five US players, according to a Reuters calculation from company statements. Overall sales at BNP's corporate and institutional banking unit, which long-time CEO Jean-Laurent Bonnafe has made critical to its success, rose by 17% year-on-year. Fixed-income, currencies and commodities trading revenue was flat, reflecting an [USN:L4N4600TB TEXT:"industry wide"] weak quarter for fixed income. BNP's retail business saw income rise by 4%, boosted by higher interest rates. The bank said it would launch a €1.3 billion share buyback in November after it met its Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio, a key measure of financial strength, at end-June, ahead of schedule. RBC analysts said before the results they expected BNP to bring forward a buyback totalling €1.2 billion euros "to express confidence in its outlook". ($1 = 0.8961 euros)

item.title: Colten Ellis stops 23 shots as Sabres shut out Sharks
item.description: Colten Ellis made 23 saves for the Buffalo Sabres to earn his second career shutout in a 2-0 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Colten Ellis made 23 saves for the Buffalo Sabres to earn his second career shutout in a 2-0 win against the host San Jose Sharks on Tuesday. It was Ellis' first appearance since getting pulled early in the second period on Oct. 12 against the Florida Panthers, when he gave up two goals on nine shots. His lone previous shutout came on April 9 against the Columbus Blue Jackets Olen Zellweger and Zach Benson scored for the Sabres, who snapped a three-game skid (0-1-2). Owen Power assisted on both tallies. Yaroslav Askarov made 38 saves for the Sharks, who have lost two in a row. Zellweger put Buffalo up 1-0 early in the second period. Konsta Helenius took a feed from Power inside his own zone to the red line and dished it over to Zellweger. The smooth-skating defenseman carried it up the left wing before snapping it from the top of the circle inside the far post 50 seconds into the frame. Benson scored an empty-net goal at 19:05 of the third period. He stole the puck from Ivar Stenberg in the San Jose zone and held off the rookie in a battle toward the net, swatting the puck in for his first of the season. The two sides traded chances in the first period, with Buffalo edging San Jose 16-12 in shots on goal through 20 minutes. Midway through the period, Askarov denied Jack Quinn with a chest save on a chance off the rush. Late in the frame, Ellis got his blocker on a quick shot from Adam Gaudette from the slot on a power play. A minute and a half later, Askarov stopped Tage Thompson from the high slot and then sprawled to swallow up the rebound with Benson on the doorstep. The Sabres outshot the Sharks 14-4 in the second period, but Ellis was sharp despite limited activity, including a stop on Collin Graf off a feed from Macklin Celebrini. Late in the third, Ellis denied Kiefer Sherwood, closing the pads in time to hold off the forward's shot from the slot. --Field Level Media

item.title: NYで犬のハロウィーンパレード、仮装で街に笑顔
item.description: ハロウィーンを前に、ニューヨークでは犬たちが一足早く、とっておきの仮装を披露した。恒例の「トンプキンズ・スクエア・ハロウィーン・ドッグ・パレード」は、今回で36回目を迎えた。 17日、仮装した犬と飼い主たちがイーストビレッジに集まった。アベニューBを通ってトンプキンズ・スクエア公園へと行進し、参加者たちは互いの創意工夫と絆をたたえた。 ライオンのたてがみを着けた犬もいれば、ホラー映画のキャラクター「チャッキー」に扮した犬もいた。ローマ教皇姿の犬は、小さな白いオープンカーに乗って登場。黒い犬は恐竜の着ぐるみから顔をのぞかせ、そばには「恐竜に餌を与えないで」と書かれた看板があった。 ある参加者は、犬たちと仮装を楽しむことで、街に喜びや一体感が生まれると話した。 マンハッタン初のドッグランで始まったこのイベントは、今では仮装コンテストのほか、参加者や見物客が楽しめる街区の催しも開かれるようになった。

item.title: Brewers sell out World Series watch party as fans await first title
item.description: MILWAUKEE -- More than 30,000 title-starved Brewers fans turned out to watch a baseball game played 1,200 miles away, but they will have to wait at least one more day to see their dream fulfilled.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MILWAUKEE -- More than 30,000 title-starved Brewers fans turned out to watch a baseball game played 1,200 miles away, but they will have to wait at least one more day to see their dream fulfilled. The visiting Milwaukee Brewers were on the brink of the first World Series title in franchise history when the Tampa Bay Rays rallied for two runs in the bottom of the 12th inning to avoid a sweep in Game 4 and stay alive with a 4-3 victory Tuesday night in St. Petersburg, Fla. After winning the first two games at home, the Brewers hosted watch parties at American Family Field for Games 3 and 4, with ticket sales capped at 31,000 for each game. Proceeds from the $15 tickets benefited the Brewers Community Foundation, the team's official charitable arm. The Brewers have not yet announced an official watch party for Game 5 on Wednesday night, although one is expected. Even with hordes of Brewers fans making the trip to Tropicana Field, each of the first two official watch parties in Milwaukee sold out within 20 minutes, according to MLB.com. Fans filled all three decks of the 41,900-seat stadium from foul pole to foul pole, with only the outfield sections unsold. Dozens of bars, restaurants and gathering places throughout the Milwaukee metropolitan area and across Wisconsin also hosted watch parties. The Brewers, whose only other World Series appearance was a seven-game loss to the St. Louis Cardinals in 1982, issued nearly 100 media credentials for the Tuesday watch party, said Megan Kendall of the Brewers' media relations. Tickets for the Game 4 watch party at the stadium were selling for $293 on the secondary market one hour before game time. Facebook Marketplace was filled with "ISO" (in search of) postings from fans still looking for last-minute tickets to watch the game on the 12,077-square-foot screen in center field. But it wasn't just the fans who were caught up in the postseason enthusiasm. "I'm just so excited to be here," said Debra Dinsmore, a member of Brewers' guest relations who greets fans with a smile at almost every home game from her post at one of the escalators near the right field gate. "At the beginning, I wasn't sure, but at this point I'm glad we're here and we're doing it tonight." Kay Kenealy of nearby Waukesha, Wis., had a 20-game ticket package during the regular season and attended the first two World Series games in Milwaukee. "It just sounded like a crazy, fun thing to do. So I decided to do it," said Kenealy, who said she has been a Brewers fan since the team moved to Milwaukee in 1970 as the relocated Seattle Pilots. "You get the stadium atmosphere without having to fly 1,200 miles to do it." "If not tonight, then tomorrow night," Kenealy said. "I do not need them to come back to Milwaukee to win the World Series. I want them to get it done." --Jim Hoehn, Field Level Media

item.title: 中国ＣＸＭＴ、高度ＡＩメモリー生産開始へ 歩留まり低いままで
item.description: [２８日 ロイター] - 中国の半導体メーカー、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は、ＡＩ（人工知能）プロセッサーと共に使用さ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国ＣＸＭＴ、高度ＡＩメモリー生産開始へ　歩留まり低いままで 14:41 配信

写真はＣＸＭＴのロゴ。7月29日、北京で撮影。 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov（ロイター） [２８日 ロイター] - 中国の半導体メーカー、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は、ＡＩ（人工知能）プロセッサーと共に使用される高度な高帯域メモリー（ＨＢＭ）「ＨＢＭ３Ｅ」の生産を開始する計画だが、歩留まりはわずか２０─３０％程度にとどまっている。関係筋２人が明らかにした。

この決定は中国におけるＡＩ向け半導体メモリー不足を浮き彫りにしている。

同筋によると、ＣＸＭＴは複数の国内ＡＩチップ設計企業にＨＢＭ３Ｅのサンプルを送付。同社は今後２カ月以内に限定的な生産を開始する見込み。

市場をリードする韓国ＳＫハイニックスの歩留まりは約７０％という。

ＨＢＭ製造の難しさは、ＣＸＭＴと、ＳＫハイニックスをはじめとする世界の供給を支配する業界リーダーとの間の格差も浮き彫りにしている。

ＣＸＭＴはコメント要請に応じなかった。

item.title: India's GST clarification on brokerage modestly positive for FPIs, analysts say
item.description: The Indian government's clarification that brokerage paid by overseas clients can qualify as exports and avoid goods and services tax (GST), subject to certain conditions, is sentimentally positive for foreign investors, analysts said, at a time when record outflows have battered domestic stocks.
item.dc:creator: Vivek M
item.content:encoded: The Indian government's clarification that brokerage paid by overseas clients can qualify as exports and avoid goods and services tax (GST), subject to certain conditions, is sentimentally positive for foreign investors, analysts said, at a time when record outflows have battered domestic stocks. The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs in a circular dated October 26 said that brokerage paid through repatriable rupee accounts, from which funds can be moved out of India, could count as an export of services and therefore be exempt from GST. India levies 18% GST on brokerage fees. Full-service brokers typically charge brokerage between 0.01% and 0.55% on the value of shares traded. The clarification could reduce the GST burden on foreign portfolio investors, and any increase in trading volumes would be positive for brokerage firms and depositories, Jefferies said in a note on Tuesday. Foreign investors have offloaded Indian shares worth $32.66 billion so far this year, well above the previous annual record of $18.91 billion in 2025, according to National Securities Depository data. India's benchmark Nifty 50 index (.NSEI) is down 13.6% in 2026, setting the stage for its worst annual performance in over a decade, while MSCI's emerging markets index (.dMIEF00000PUS) has risen 12.4%. The GST clarification is "sentimentally positive but may not make much of a difference, especially for FPI mood.... However, a decision on capital gains (tax) could provide much needed relief," said Ambareesh Baliga, an independent market analyst in Mumbai. The move comes amid speculation about a potential cut in the capital gains tax. The Indian Express newspaper earlier this week reported that the government is discussing lowering long-term capital gains tax from 12.5% for both domestic and foreign investors in the run-up to the federal budget next year.

DAMASCUS: Syria reopened its main border crossing with Jordan on Wednesday (Oct 28) as the two countries reaffirmed ties that were strained by a deadly retaliatory strike by Jordanian forces. Jordan's strike - a reprisal against a gun attack on a church - sparked the worst crisis between the two countries since the ousting of longtime Syrian ruler Bashar al-Assad in December 2024. Syria condemned the strikes on the country's south as an "unacceptable violation", while Jordan said it killed more than 20 militant fighters in its raid. Jordan sought to ease tensions on Tuesday, saying it had "great respect" for its neighbour and expressed regret for civilian casualties.

The main Nassib border crossing, known as Jaber on the Jordanian side, was closed following the strikes, but passenger and commercial movement will return to normal as of Wednesday morning, senior Syrian customs official Mazen Alloush told state news agency SANA. Last week, gunmen opened fire during a funeral service at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Jordan's Karak governorate, killing nine people and wounding 25 - prompting a military response from Amman. While Jordan insisted it coordinated its airstrikes with Syria, Damascus denied the claim, and Syria's civil defence agency said the raids killed seven people, including three children. On Tuesday, Jordan's Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi spoke to his Syrian counterpart and emphasised Jordan's "full respect for Syria's sovereignty ... and security", while also expressing "sorrow and grief over the death of innocent civilian victims", according to a joint statement. The two officials also discussed the raids against what the statement branded as "Daesh sites", using an acronym to refer to the Islamic State (IS) group. Earlier, Jordan's government spokesman Mohammad al-Momani had said that "the preliminary results... indicate significant losses among Daesh's ranks - estimated at more than 20 fighters". He also said "a large weapons depot belonging to the organisation" had been destroyed. "BLATANT VIOLATION" Earlier, Syria's foreign ministry issued a "condemnation and rejection" of the strikes, calling them "an unacceptable violation and breach of Syrian airspace without any prior coordination". It also said the raid was "a blatant violation of the principles of good-neighbourliness and Syrian national sovereignty". In the coming days, a joint Syrian-Jordanian security committee will meet to discuss the operations against IS, a government source told Syrian state news agency SANA. Syria said five people, including a woman and three children, were killed in the village of Al-Taf in Daraa province, which borders Jordan, with two other people killed elsewhere in the south. "We were asleep when the missile hit us. My mother, my older brother and his three children - two boys and a girl - were killed," said Nassouh al-Salim in Al-Taf, staring at a grey body bag. An AFP reporter saw a huge crater in the family's destroyed home, with school books, clothes and the remains of furniture strewn among the rubble. Syrian Emergencies and Disaster Management Minister Raed al-Saleh said on Tuesday that both sides were handling the dispute through "diplomatic and legal channels" with the aim of securing justice for the victims. "DARK IDEOLOGIES" On Monday, Amman said authorities had arrested three Jordanians accused of the church killings , two of them brothers and the other related by marriage. Authorities said the suspects were hospitalised after being wounded in a shootout with security forces. Karak is home to a significant Christian community in Muslim-majority Jordan, where Christians make up between two and three per cent of the population. "We vowed the terrorists would not escape punishment, and no proponent of dark ideologies that divide Jordanians will be tolerated," King Abdullah II said. IS was territorially defeated in Syria in 2019, after it seized swathes of territory during the country's more than 13-year civil war. But remnants are still present, and the group occasionally claims attacks, mainly targeting Syrian security forces. The group has previously been present in parts of Daraa province.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: インドネシアとシンガポール、煙害対策の共同タスクフォース設置を検討
item.description:
Stanley Widianto Xinghui Kok
［ジャカルタ ２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Stanley Widianto　Xinghui Kok

［ジャカルタ　２７日　ロイター］ - シンガポールのバラクリシュナン外相とインドネシアのナシル外相が２７日、ジャカルタで会談した。両国間に緊張をもたらしているインドネシアの森林火災による煙害について、共同で対処するタスクフォースの設置について協議した。

ナシル氏は会談後、タスクフォースの内容について、情報の共有、国境を越えた証拠の収集に加え、森林火災に関連した企業からの資産回収さえ視野に入れていると説明。「これらの企業の資金の流れを追跡しなければならない。シンガポールからは、火災に関連した企業に関するデータ提供の申し出があった」と語った。

バラクリシュナン氏は「シンガポールはインドネシアと連帯している。（煙害は）共通の課題であり、共同で取り組むのが最も効果的だ」と述べた。

今回の火災はインドネシアで呼吸器系疾患の急増を引き起こし、シンガポール、マレーシア、東ティモールにも煙害を及ぼしている。ナシル氏は、インドネシア、シンガポール両国はこの火災について率直に話し合えるほど成熟していると述べた。

インドネシアが今月、国内供給の確保を理由にシンガポールへの天然ガス供給の削減を決定したことについては、両外相とも触れなかった。

item.title: GAIL India to invest $63 million in heating unit at Ratnagiri LNG terminal, executive says
item.description: GAIL India is investing 6 billion rupees ($63.1 million) to build a heating unit at its Ratnagiri LNG terminal to help it gasify the super-chilled fuel, the company's business development director told reporters on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: GAIL India (GAIL.NS) is investing 6 billion rupees ($63.1 million) to build a heating unit at its Ratnagiri LNG terminal to help it gasify the super-chilled fuel, the company's business development director told reporters on Wednesday. The facility, due to be completed by June 2027, will enable the company to run the LNG terminal at its full capacity of 5 million tons per annum, R. K. Singhal said at an industry event. The facility is operating at about 50% capacity as the heating unit is not ready, Singhal said. The Ratnagiri facility was generating heat through the waste of a power plant operated by another entity to gasify the fuel. That plant is not functional now, he said. GAIL is also building a small size captive power plant to generate heat for the liquefied natural gas facility, he added. ($1 = 95.1150 Indian rupees)

item.title: Philippines will defend peso 'as hard as we possibly can', president says
item.description: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr said on Wednesday authorities would do all they can to ensure the peso does not keep falling against the dollar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr said on Wednesday authorities would do all they can to ensure the peso does not keep falling against the dollar. "People can take solace in the fact that our policy towards the peso is to continue to defend the peso as hard as we possibly can," Marcos told reporters. Marcos said the government has "all the means to defend" the currency, which hit a record low of 64.17 to the dollar on Tuesday There was no reason to panic over its weakness, he said "Our foreign exchange reserves are healthy. And that’s what we draw on to defend the peso," he added Philippine foreign reserves fell to $99.5 billion in September, the lowest level since September 2023 The peso has lost more than 8% against the dollar so far this year The governor of the central bank last week said it intervenes in the foreign exchange market to smooth out sharp fluctuations The central bank raised its key policy rate by a [USN:L1N46809C TEXT:"larger-than-expected 50 basis points"] last week to combat inflation, which it said could be fueled by a weaker peso through higher imports Marcos, who had met central bank officials on Tuesday, said monetary measures could only do so much to control inflation, adding "we have to do others"

item.title: 印マルチ・スズキ、下期は収益性改善へ 販売増と値上げで
item.description:
Saikeerthi .
[２７日 ロイター] - インド自動車最大手マルチ・スズキ・インディアは、今年度下期に販売...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
印マルチ・スズキ、下期は収益性改善へ　販売増と値上げで 14:29 配信

写真はマルチ・スズキの工場。2023年9月、インド北部ハリヤナ州マネサールで撮影。 REUTERS/Anushree Fadnavis（ロイター） Saikeerthi .

[２７日 ロイター] - インド自動車最大手マルチ・スズキ・インディアは、今年度下期に販売台数増加と追加値上げで収益性が改善するとの見通しを示した。７─９月期はコスト上昇が響き、利益が市場予想を下回った。

インドの自動車メーカーは、鉄鋼や銅など主要原材料の価格高騰に直面している。中東紛争の長期化で状況が悪化する中、収益性が圧迫され、値上げを迫られている。

同社の竹内寿志社長兼最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算説明会で、「今後６カ月間に適切なタイミングでの値上げを計画しており、収益状況の一段の改善に寄与するだろう」と述べた。

同社は、１月から予定している生産能力増強が、下期の販売台数を２桁増とする目標達成に寄与するとの見通しも示した。

また通期の輸出台数について、中東紛争に伴う混乱はあるものの、海外市場の底堅い需要に支えられ、過去最高だった２０２５年度の水準を上回ると見込んでいる。

７─９月期の利益は前年同期比２７％減の２４１億５０００万ルピーとなり、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の３１０億５０００万ルピーを下回った。中核事業の営業利益率は９．４％と、前年同期の１２．１％から低下した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：インド、待望の民間投資復活の兆し　政府主導から成長エンジン多様化 コラム：ＡＩ雇用ショック、インド経済を揺るがすか アングル：結婚式前に手っ取り早くやせたい　インドで適用外の肥満症治療薬利用が増加 アングル：インド証券、外国人が大幅売り越し　原油高による経済悪化懸念 アングル：インド進出を加速する英大学、移民抑制受け国外に活路 10/28(水) 14:29 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Japan's Nidec likely to miss audit opinion by month-end, Nikkei says
item.description: Japan's Nidec will likely not be able to obtain an auditor's opinion on its securities report by month-end after an auditor said an audit would not be completed in time, the Nikkei business daily reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan's Nidec (6594.T) will likely not be able to obtain an auditor's opinion on its securities report by month-end after an auditor said an audit would not be completed in time, the Nikkei business daily reported on Wednesday. The Japanese electric motor maker will submit internal control documents to the Tokyo Stock Exchange by the deadline without the opinion from the auditor PwC Japan, seeking early review on listing maintenance, the Nikkei reported without citing sources. Nidec said [USN:L2N46D09T TEXT:"on Tuesday"] it had decided to sue founder Shigenobu Nagamori and eight other former executives for damages over suspected accounting irregularities that have put its stock market listing at risk.

item.title: Weak domestic returns fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
item.description: India's top money managers are launching a flurry of funds in a tax-neutral hub to absorb the record sums that domestic investors are sending overseas, frustrated by weak returns at home and craving exposure to AI-related assets.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi, Dharamraj Dhutia
item.content:encoded: India's top money managers are launching a flurry of funds in a tax-neutral hub to absorb the record sums that domestic investors are sending overseas, frustrated by weak returns at home and craving exposure to AI-related assets. At least half a dozen such funds have been launched in the past six months, including the JioBlackRock Advantage World Equity Fund this week by the joint venture of Mukesh Ambani's Jio Financial (JIOF.NS) and BlackRock (BLK.N) , the world's largest asset manager. The overseas investment rush poses a dilemma for policymakers, who have spent years encouraging households to move savings from real estate, gold and bank deposits into domestic equities. The world's most populous nation has more than 130 million retail stock investors, many of whom are scouring for investment targets abroad, from New York to Kazakhstan, after sustained underperformance in the domestic stock market. "Over the last two years, we've seen a clear increase in demand for global assets," said Shobhit Mathur, co-founder of money manager Ionic Asset. "Investors are no longer looking at overseas exposure as a tactical allocation but increasingly as a permanent part of portfolio construction." International investments by individuals in India either directly or through funds more than doubled from a year earlier to nearly $2.3 billion in the first half of 2026, on track to surpass the 2025 full year's record $2.65 billion, data from the central bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), showed. One such investor is Ankit Khandelwal, a 41-year-old resident of Kota in the western Indian state of Rajasthan who invests in global exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and companies listed in markets such as Kazakhstan and Mongolia. "It began as an experiment but since then better returns overseas and persistent rupee weakness has led me to grow the overseas portion of my portfolio to over 60% from about 5% in early 2025," said Khandelwal, who is an import and export adviser to companies, adding that he understands metals, mining and energy firms of the world. India's rupee currency hit a record low this year as its stock market suffered sustained selling by institutional investors and as its economy was hit by rising energy costs from the Iran war. The South Asian nation caps overseas remittances at an annual $250,000 per person because its currency is not fully convertible. The benchmark Nifty 50 index (.NSEI) is down 5.3% over the last two years, compared with a 47% gain in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (.dMIEF00000PUS) and a 32% rise in the S&P 500 (.SPX) in the US. High valuations and a lack of AI-related stocks have also weighed on returns from local equities. Little wonder then that retail trading account openings for domestic investments fell by a quarter to 33 million in the fiscal year ending March 2026, data from Indian depositories showed. GIFT CITY The RBI restricts Indian funds to a maximum cumulative overseas investment of $7 billion and a $1 billion limit for an individual asset manager. With the limits almost exhausted, funds cannot create fresh units to invest at will even as demand grows. But these limits do not apply to overseas investment funds of domestic asset managers launched through the GIFT City tax-neutral hub located in India's western Gujarat state. Thus, besides JioBlackRock, HDFC Asset Management, Parag Parikh and Aditya Birla Sun Life have launched such funds in the last six months. Other domestic funds that invest in foreign equities too are sought after, despite the RBI limits. Assets in overseas fund-of-funds schemes rose 42% year-on-year to 488 billion rupees in September, while investors registered for such investments climbed 34% to nearly 2 million, according to data published by the Association of Mutual Funds in India. The paucity of overseas investment avenues for Indian investors has driven some overseas ETFs to trade at hefty premiums to their net asset values. One such fund, the Motilal Oswal Nasdaq Q50 ETF, traded as much as 65% to 80% above the value of its underlying portfolio at times in September, while some Mirae Asset overseas ETFs commanded premiums of 27% to 58%. REGULATORS CAUTIOUS Retail investors are also racing to gain direct exposure to US and other overseas stocks, with discount brokers Groww (BILO.NS) , Zerodha and Angel One (ANGO.NS) launching fractional investing platforms this month. Similar investment trends are underway in a number of markets, [USN:L4N4560L0 TEXT:"including China"], where regulators have tightened scrutiny of unofficial channels through which money is being sent overseas. Indian authorities are cautious about the money flowing abroad from such investments but are not considering measures to curb such flows, three people at Indian regulators told Reuters. Emails to India's market regulator and the RBI, which sets overseas investment limits, were not answered. Some industry executives voiced caution. "Indian markets have not given returns and overseas markets are looking attractive," said Swarup Mohanty, chief executive of Mirae Asset Investment Managers. "If you want to invest for diversification then it's fine, but investing purely to chase short-term returns is worrying." ($1 = 95.1350 Indian rupees)

item.title: A Cruise Ship Was Their Home. Now Villa Vie Residents Must Leave
item.description: For the past two years, Lanette Canen and Johan Bodin have used social media to chronicle their lives on the Villa Vie Odyssey, a cruise ship that was on an around-the-world trip until it ran out of fuel in Cambodia.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- For the past two years, Lanette Canen and Johan Bodin have used social media to chronicle their lives on the Villa Vie Odyssey, a cruise ship that was on an around-the-world trip until it ran out of fuel in Cambodia.Now, their dream voyage appears over. The couple are among hundreds of residents shocked by an order to disembark the ship in Sihanoukville, where the vessel has been stranded because it can’t afford fuel, which Villa Vie Residences claims has as much as quadrupled in price since the Iran War began.“Lanette’s not happy that she’s getting up but we have six hours to pack our belongings — in Cambodia, in Sihanoukville,” Johan said in a YouTube video on Tuesday, when he disclosed the Odyssey was ordering all passengers to disembark by 2 p.m. that day. “I don’t want to leave,” said Lanette. About 200 residents were aboard the 650-passenger ship when disembarkation was ordered, Villa Vie founder Mikael Petterson said in a telephone interview, noting the company is set to cover lodging and local transportation, but not the cost of travel out of Cambodia.The company “recognizes that this is a difficult and disruptive period for residents, crew members, and employees,” it said in a statement. The Odyssey’s travails are a microcosm of the damage caused to businesses by the US war on Iran, which this week sent Brent crude over $115 a barrel. It also raises questions over Villa Vie’s investment model: the company sells cabins for permanent residency at prices ranging from under $130,000 to $440,000, plus monthly fees of $2,000 to $10,000, according to its brochure.The Odyssey began its world voyage in October 2024, and its arrival in Cambodia follows port visits in Thailand. The company was next scheduled to go to Vietnam, though its website outlined ambitious long-term plans for travel to destinations as far flung as Casablanca and the Caribbean, along with Greenland, Madagascar and Melbourne.But as fuel prices have climbed, so has talk of a looming crisis.In the two months before the order, Lanette and Johan say residents were repeatedly told the company was short of money, then given hope that investors or other solutions were on the way. When those plans fell through, the cycle began again. Lanette describes the experience as “emotionally exhausting,” and the couple says residents were divided over how to save the ship.Petterson said residents had balked at a request to contribute toward fuel for the ship’s departure. Villa Vie proposed an extra $500 a month, plus a fuel surcharge, and was seeking financing.The company said fuel costs had risen from a historical average of about $1,800 per cabin a month to as much as $8,000 in parts of Asia. Fuel pushed monthly costs to $3 million, and Villa Vie is considering a financial restructuring and seeking new funding over the next 60 days.But for now, many of the Odyssey’s investor-passengers remain in Sihanoukville, a one-time boomtown that during the pandemic saw criminal syndicates seize empty resorts, casinos and condos for use as industrial-scale cyber-scam compounds. A subsequent nationwide crackdown shut hundreds of illicit operations, driving out victims and syndicate bosses by the thousands, but Sihanoukville remains a ghost of its former self. A recent visit revealed padlocked casinos and abandoned scam compounds lining the coast, flanked by rows of shuttered Chinese restaurants and half-built concrete towers.“It’s a blessing for Sihanoukville,” said Ayub Yulianto, general manager of the Novotel Sihanoukville Holiday Resort. “The province has suffered from this rather negative perception, so having the cruise people in Sihanoukville hopefully creates a positive impact.”The Odyssey, itself, never operated at full capacity, according to resident Randy Cassingham, who documented his time aboard the vessel on his Residential Cruising blog where he posted the disembarkation notice.“I think we probably peaked at around 350, and there were around 200 still active at the end,” Cassingham said in an Oct. 27 update in which he criticized Villa Vie for doing little to help the stranded passengers.“The cabins were small and sparse, but that was OK: cabins were really our bedrooms and a place to shower,” he said. “But it wasn’t ‘luxury’ — it was promoted, after all, as ‘affordable’ and it was until the company started begging for money.”For some people who had looked into buying a cabin, news of the Odyssey’s stranding confirmed their decision to wait. One Reddit user said an aunt had planned to sell her home to buy one, but put the plan on hold after family members raised concerns.Several users also questioned whether the ship’s business model could work without a steady stream of new cabin buyers and payments from current residents.The ship originally left Belfast, Northern Ireland, for a “continuous” voyage around the world, according to the company’s website. Johan said he and Lanette had hoped to live aboard for 15 years or more, and that they valued their two years at sea but worried about people who had joined recently or invested their savings and retirement income.Holly Hennessy has been traveling the world aboard the Odyssey with her cat, Captain, narrating their journey on a Facebook page called Captain the Cruising Kitty. Her posts capture their unexpected life ashore, with Captain on a bed at Sihanoukville’s Independence Hotel, where Jacqueline Kennedy once stayed, and riding through the city in a tuk-tuk.“We’ve had a few months to anticipate this happening; most shipmates have gotten to a place of acceptance,” Hennessy said. “It’s still utterly heartbreaking though.”--With assistance from K. Oanh Ha, Philip J. Heijmans, Erich Parpart, Satid Sutipanya and Shadab Nazmi.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil following defeat in presidential election
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, who is facing multiple criminal investigations in Brazil, was ordered to surrender his passports to Federal Police by Tuesday but failed to do so ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Daniel Carvalho and Eric Martin Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami on Tuesday after fleeing his country following a defeat in its presidential election, O Globo reported. Bolsonaro was greeted by his brother Eduardo upon arrival, the newspaper said, citing allies. Eduardo has lived in the US since last year after moving there to lobby President Donald Trump to help their father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted of plotting a coup. A senior State Department official said earlier Tuesday that the US would grant visas to Flávio and his family.  Flávio Bolsonaro, who is facing multiple criminal investigations in Brazil, was ordered to surrender his passports to Federal Police by Tuesday but failed to do so, according to a police official familiar with the situation. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, whom the Bolsonaro family has long accused of political persecution, demanded he turn over the documents amid concerns the senator posed a flight risk. Bolsonaro’s loss to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Sunday’s runoff election dealt a massive setback to a family that had sought to cement a political dynasty in Brazil. The senator had made freeing Jair Bolsonaro, his father who is serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup after his 2022 election loss, a central theme of his campaign. Trump told reporters early Wednesday after returning from a campaign trip to Texas said he would have approved of Bolsonaro coming to the US, but thought that he was in Argentina. Speaking in Texas on Tuesday afternoon, Trump avoided mentioning Bolsonaro but reiterated his unfounded assertions that there was fraud in Brazil’s election. He assailed Democrats as the “greatest cheaters of elections” before adding that “Brazil’s doing a pretty good job also.”  The US leader has long been an ally of the Bolsonaros and last year placed tariffs on Brazilian goods in an unsuccessful bid to help Jair Bolsonaro avoid his coup trial. Flávio Bolsonaro’s whereabouts were unknown to police or allies on Tuesday morning after Infobae reported that he had crossed into Argentina and planned to travel to the US from there. Brazil police have no official record of Bolsonaro leaving Brazil, and the press secretary for Argentina President Javier Milei denied that he’d entered the country. Multiple Bolsonaro allies told Bloomberg News that they tried to contact him but had not heard back.  The saga has set social media alight with memes referring to Bolsonaro as “Flyvio,” comparing him to Carmen Sandiego or Where’s Waldo? Others have altered the conservative slogan, “God, Country and Family” to “Goodbye, Country and Family.” “The act of leaving Brazil is shameful,” Lula said at an event to mark his 81st birthday. The leftist has had a rocky relationship with Trump, and earlier this year denied visas to two senior US officials amid fears they planned to question the integrity of its electoral system. Bolsonaro is facing at least two federal investigations into allegations of money laundering, one of which stems from his links to the former Banco Master SA owner caught in Brazil’s biggest-ever bank fraud case. He’s denied wrongdoing. His actions since the Sunday vote had evoked those of his father even before the reports he was leaving Brazil. He initially said he would request the annulment of the results due to a Supreme Court decision to extend voting hours, echoing Jair Bolsonaro’s refusal to accept his narrow loss to Lula four years ago. Jair Bolsonaro left Brazil for the US after the defeat. He returned months later and was subsequently barred from holding public office for eight years for spreading false claims about Brazil’s electronic voting system ahead of the election, then convicted of plotting a coup.Supreme Court DramaFlávio Bolsonaro backed down on his plans to seek annulment of the results Monday, publishing a social media video in which he said the Supreme Court had barred him from leaving Brazil. He said the move followed comments by his brother Eduardo, who said on a podcast that Flávio should leave Brazil if he lost the election. Moraes’ decision irritated officials in Lula’s government as well as some members of the Supreme Court, according to people familiar with the matter, who asked not to be identified discussing private conversations.  Lula’s administration had wanted to focus on efforts to pacify the country and move past the polarization that has exploded during back-to-back election battles between the leftist leader and a member of the Bolsonaro family, the people said. It viewed the move from Moraes, a controversial judge who oversaw Jair Bolsonaro’s trial and has long drawn charges of censorship from the Brazilian right, as counter to those aims. Earlier Tuesday, Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered federal authorities to open an investigation into possible illegal foreign financing of Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, including by a group linked to US Vice President JD Vance.  The justice stressed that the order doesn’t establish that illegal foreign financing occurred, but said allegations leveled during Brazil’s presidential race warrant an investigation. Vance’s office didn’t respond to a request for comment. Argentina’s spokesman, Adrian Ravier, said there had been no request for asylum in Argentina from Bolsonaro during a press conference Tuesday.

item.title: Canucks halt 10-game skid with late 3-goal rally, OT win vs. Ducks
item.description: Jonathan Lekkerimaki scored twice in the final three minutes of regulation and Filip Hronek scored on a two-man advantage in overtime as the visiting Vancouver Canucks snapped a 10-game losing streak with a 6-5 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jonathan Lekkerimaki scored twice in the final three minutes of regulation and Filip Hronek scored on a two-man advantage in overtime as the visiting Vancouver Canucks snapped a 10-game losing streak with a 6-5 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday. Liam Ohgren, Brock Boeser and Jamie Oleksiak also scored for the Canucks, who trailed 5-2 with less than eight minutes remaining in regulation and won for the first time since Oct. 3. Boeser and Elias Pettersson each had two assists. Leevi Merilainen made 18 saves for Vancouver, which scored the winner with 10.4 seconds remaining in overtime on a one-timer by Hronek from the slot. A.J. Greer scored twice and Jackson LaCombe had three assists as the Ducks lost for the sixth time in their past seven games. Leo Carlsson and Jeff Malott each had a goal and an assist while Beckett Sennecke also scored for Anaheim. Lukas Dostal made 27 saves for the Ducks, who lost for the eighth time in nine home games against the Canucks since December 2021. With Vancouver trailing 5-3, Lekkerimaki beat Dostal from inside the left circle at 17:14 of the third period, then tied the game on a shot through traffic from beyond the left circle with just under two minutes remaining in regulation. The Ducks took a 1-0 lead just over four minutes into the game when Greer scored off Hronek's stick. Vancouver drew even 6:36 into the second period when Ohgren put a rebound past Dostal after a shot hit Anaheim's Tristan Luneau. The Ducks went ahead 2-1 just 30 seconds later when Malott tapped in a centering pass from LaCombe. Sennecke made it 3-1 at 15:44 of the second period on the power play when the puck caromed off his left leg following a shot by Cutter Gauthier. Carlsson scored at 18:24 to extend the lead to 4-1. The Canucks pulled within 4-2 on Boeser's goal at 11:40 of the third, but the Ducks answered 43 seconds later when Greer deflected the puck in from the edge of the crease for a 5-2 advantage. Oleksiak set the stage for Lekkerimaki's late heroics with an unassisted goal at 12:54 to cut Vancouver's deficit to 5-3. --Field Level Media

item.title: AI chips worth $12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says
item.description: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling high-performance semiconductors through the country's main airport.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling high-performance semiconductors through the country's main airport. Malaysia [USN:L6N3TB03O TEXT:"imposed export controls"] last year on the movement of advanced AI chips of US origin, following pressure from the United States to stem their flow into China On October 15, authorities found 30 server units containing advanced AI chips during an inspection at Kuala Lumpur International Airport's free trade zone, the airport's customs director Aspalila Ag Tuah told reporters Initial investigations found that the shipment, originating from an Asian country, was to be re-exported to another nation in the continent, a move that required a trade permit, she said "The servers were falsely declared as electronic components... and shipped through Malaysia to ensure there would be no restrictions imposed while being exported to the next destination," Aspalila said A Malaysian firm that facilitated the shipment has been called in to assist investigations, he added The shipment was suspected to have been carried out by a network responsible for a [USN:L6N42X0OH TEXT:"similar smuggling attempt"] foiled by customs authorities in June, she said At least five cases were linked to the syndicate, involving seizures of chips worth more than 100 million ringgit in total, she said, declining to divulge further details citing an ongoing probe ($1 = 4.0870 ringgit)

item.title: ＡＩ投資でプライベートクレジット市場拡大、借り換えリスク浮上＝ムーディーズ
item.description: ［２７日 ロイター］ - 米格付け会社ムーディーズ・レーティングスは２７日、人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ整備を支えるための借...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ投資でプライベートクレジット市場拡大、借り換えリスク浮上＝ムーディーズ 14:20 配信

写真のイラストは10月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［２７日　ロイター］ - 米格付け会社ムーディーズ・レーティングスは２７日、人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラ整備を支えるための借り入れ増大により、プライベートクレジット市場が従来の企業向け融資の枠を超えて広がっている一方、今後数年で返済期限を迎える融資が集中し、財務基盤の弱い借り手が借り換えに苦戦する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

・ムーディーズによると、ＡＩ関連の資金需要はデータセンター建設にとどまらず、用地取得や電力設備、半導体、ＧＰＵ（画像処理半導体）、ＴＰＵ（テンソル処理ユニット）に拡大している。

・同社は、米国の主要ハイパースケーラー５社とＡＩクラウドサービス企業コアウィーブの設備投資額が２０２７年に累計で約１兆ドルに達すると予測。資金は営業キャッシュフローのほか、負債調達や合弁事業、特別目的会社（ＳＰＶ）などの仕組みを通じて賄われるとしている。

・だが２７年から２９年にかけて多額の融資が返済期限を迎える見通しで、金利上昇局面において信用力の低い借り手の借り換え能力が試されると指摘した。

・ムーディーズが追跡する６０７社の借り手のうち約１７％は、現金での利払いを先送りできるＰＩＫ（ペイメント・イン・カインド）金利を利用している。利払い負担を繰り延べできる半面、債務残高の増加につながる仕組みだ。

・ロイターが今年実施した分析では、米国のビジネス・デベロップメント・カンパニー（ＢＤＣ）が保有するローンの満期到来は２８年と２９年にピークを迎える。

・最近のコアウィーブの債務を巡る市場の動揺は、高いレバレッジを抱えるＡＩ関連企業に対する投資家の警戒感の高まりを浮き彫りにした。

・ムーディーズは、テクノロジー企業や半導体メーカー、ＡＩ開発企業が相互に出資や融資、製品購入を行うケースが増えていることから「循環型」の資金調達リスクにも警鐘を鳴らした。景気後退時にはこうした相関性の高いエクスポージャーが同時に悪化する恐れがあるという。

item.title: Vietnam financial centre says its first 10 members to mobilise $2.7 billion
item.description: Vietnam's International Financial Center said on Wednesday its first 10 members are expected to mobilise and invest about $2.7 billion in the country's business hub Ho Chi Minh City through 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam's [USN:L4N3SU0A4 TEXT:"International Financial Center"] said on Wednesday its first 10 members are expected to mobilise and invest about $2.7 billion in the country's business hub Ho Chi Minh City through 2027. Among the initial 10 members are holding companies linked to Keppel Asset Management, AG&P LNG and VinaCapital International Partners, the centre said in a statement. Those members are expected to invest about $2.7 billion and have disclosed commitments to mobilise more than $2 billion for infrastructure, energy, data centres, education and renewable energy projects, it said In addition, Keppel is exploring co-investment platforms with global partners that could mobilise up to $1 billion more, it said The government is focusing on international financial centres in Ho Chi Minh City and Danang as part of a broader strategy to attract foreign investment, deepen capital markets and strengthen Vietnam's role in regional finance Under legislation approved last year, financial centre members will be allowed to access international financing and conduct transactions in foreign currencies The centres will operate under international accounting and financial standards, including capital adequacy and liquidity requirements applicable to both domestic and foreign-owned banks

item.title: Raphael Lavoie's first NHL goal leads Golden Knights past Senators
item.description: Raphael Lavoie's first NHL goal was the go-ahead tally midway through the third period as the Vegas Golden Knights earned a 4-1 victory over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night in Las Vegas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Raphael Lavoie's first NHL goal was the go-ahead tally midway through the third period as the Vegas Golden Knights earned a 4-1 victory over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night in Las Vegas. Braeden Bowman, William Karlsson and Jack Eichel also scored goals for Vegas, which snapped a season-high three-game losing streak (0-2-1). Adin Hill stopped 25 shots for the win. Shane Pinto scored a goal and Jonas Johansson stopped 25 of 27 shots for Ottawa, which was playing the first game of a five-game road trip. The Senators have alternated wins and losses for eight games. Ottawa, which outshot Vegas 11-4 in the opening period, nearly took a 1-0 lead at the start of the second period. However, Hill made a highlight-reel save on Tim Stutzle's backdoor one-timer from the right side of the net, diving across the crease and sticking his arm out to block the shot. Vegas jumped in front with 11 seconds remaining in the second period on a power-play goal by Bowman. He tapped in a rebound of an Ivan Barbashev shot in front of the crease. The score came just after Hill had raced out to the right circle to poke the puck away from Ridly Greig as he broke in on a breakaway. Ottawa tied it 33 seconds into the third period on a power-play goal by Pinto. He went in on a breakaway and fired a wrist shot past Hill's low glove side and inside the right post. The Golden Knights regained the lead 2-1 at the 8:01 mark when Lavoie slammed in the rebound of a Nic Dowd shot inside the right post. Lavoie, 26, was playing in his 27th career NHL game, his 10th this season. Vegas sealed the win with a pair of empty-net goals, the first by Karlsson on a breakaway with two minutes left, the second on Eichel's backhand shot from the blue line with seven seconds to go. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝レイズが逆転サヨナラで初勝利、ブルワーズＷＳ優勝持ち越し
item.description: ［２７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２７日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２７日、ワールドシリーズ（ＷＳ、７回戦制）の第４戦を行い、ここまで３連敗のレイズが延長十二回までもつれ込んだ試合でブルワーズを４─３で破り、初優勝に辛くも望みをつないだ。

レイズは二回にチャンドラー・シンプソン左翼手の適時二塁打で１─０とすると、四回にクーパー・プラット遊撃手の適時二塁打で同点とされる。四回に相手のエラーなどで２─１と勝ち越すも、五回にデービッド・ハミルトン三塁手のポストシーズン２号ソロで再び同点とされる。

両者その後は得点を奪うことができず、試合は延長戦へ。レイズは十二回にプラットのポストシーズン１号ソロで勝ち越され、万事休すかと思われた。

しかしその裏にジョニー・デルーカ中堅手の中前適時打で試合を振り出しに戻すと、代打で入ったベン・ウィリアムソン選手が起用に応え、値千金の適時打。レイズが粘って第５戦につなげた。

item.title: 台湾中銀、来年利上げも 物価大幅上振れなら＝総裁
item.description:
[台北 ２８日 ロイター] - 台湾中央銀行の楊金龍総裁は２８日、消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率が２０２７年に２％を大幅に上回れば利上げを実施すると述べた。
• 立法院（国会）で「来年のＣＰＩ上昇率は２％前後になると見込まれ、これは許容できる水準だ。だが、それを大きく上回る場合には利上げを行う」と述べた。
• ＣＰＩ上昇率が２％を超えて推移してはならないと述べたことはないとし、２％はあくまで目安だと説明した。
• また、米国と台湾では物価情勢が異なり、台湾が米国の利上げに追随するわけではないとし、「台湾には独自の状況がある」と述べた。
• 台湾中銀は先月、市場の予想通り政策金利を据え置いた。ハイテク主導で経済は力強く、インフレが比較的緩やかであることを踏まえた措置だが、政策スタンスは引き締め方向との認識を示した。

• ＣＰＩ上昇率が２％を超えて推移してはならないと述べたことはないとし、２％はあくまで目安だと説明した。
